help_headline: A little help in the kitchen.
faq_dates_body: Enter the date printed on packaging. Fridgy reminders are not a guarantee of freshness or safety. Always check storage instructions and food condition.
faq_scanner_title: Can the scanner read every label?
faq_scanner_body: No. The scanner is a sample AI preview. Review names and quantities. If a date is unclear, type it in yourself—Fridgy never guesses a safety date.
faq_inventory_body: Only after you confirm adding food, quantities used, or purchased items. A recipe suggestion or checked shopping row does not change it.
faq_share_title: How do I share my kitchen?
faq_share_body: Open Profile → Household Management → Invite a member. Your household shares inventory, shopping and meal plans.
